description: Kindi 0.6: fast local LLM inference on low-cost GPUs and CPUs. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (552B) at 18.7 tok/s on one RTX 3060 12 GB with a dual-Xeon DDR4 server. Ternary Bonsai 2B-27B, AH-Nanbeige4.3-33B, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B. NVIDIA from the Quadro K420 to the RTX 50 series, AMD Radeon graphics, Windows and Linux. OpenAI-compatible server.
